text.text_excerpt: Fantastic atmosphere. Make a reservation several days in advance or just sit at the bar. The bar tenders are amazing. I got a sazerac and it was very good but sweeter than i am used to. Good though. Got the squash and ricotta empenadas to start and they were fantastic. I am not a squash guy but she is. they was awesome and i would get a million of them. the bring out steak sauces at the same time that are also good on the empenadas. the three sauces are all good; parsley pesto, horseradish, paprika. all great. I got the Kobe and it was amazing. The rub was a little too salty for me but overall fantastic. She got the La Boca which was the winner of the night in my opinion. Just really real...

This is a great place to get steak - their sweetbreads, cheese, and sides were also delicious (the fries and flash fried brussels sprouts are a must - the asparagus was okay). I'd recommend making a reservation - it was crowded when we went on a Friday evening. Both my and my husband's steaks were cooked to perfection. Would definitely recommend if you're in the mood for steak. Their new location is also much nicer than the old location.

Yeah so my buddy who is a chef in New Orleans and I are talking about where to go to dinner and he recommends this place and he says look I know what you are thinking but you have to try this place and I am coming with you. He was right, La Boca is definitely one of the gems on the NOLA dining scene and we will definitely return soon. The space is beautiful and the circular bar is very cool. The staff is awesome and friendly and we had a great time. The empanadas were awesome as was the salad, but the star of the apps was definitely the sweetbreads. If you are someone who thinks that you have had them in all ways, get the sweetbreads here they are seriously out of this world. For entrees ...
